about_me: I'm a CS student at Michigan and a software engineering intern. I build my own tooling, play brass in jazz settings, and follow the Detroit hardware scene. This month I'm trying to land a summer 2027 VC internship and I'm looking for people building accessible hardware.

card.headline: CS @ Michigan · builds tooling · jazz brass
can_offer: intros in the Ann Arbor student-founder scene

debriefs: Met Maya Okafor at JacHacks. She works on accessible robotics at the Michigan Robotics lab, knows Arjun Patel from their lab, and wants feedback from wheelchair users on her prototype. I promised to send her our demo.
Coffee with Leo Brandt, designs accessible interfaces at a Detroit startup. He offered to review prototypes for anyone building accessibility tools, a couple a month. Last talked in August.
Priya Nair, second-year at Ross, spent the summer at a Chicago growth fund. Said she'd happily talk to anyone thinking about VC internships. Knows Sam Reyes from the fund.
Sam Reyes (not the other Sam), associate at a climate-tech fund in Chicago. Met once at a2Tech360. Mentioned they're hiring summer analysts in the spring.
Sam Ortiz from the Newlab thing, hardware founder, battery analytics. Wants an intro to anyone doing power electronics. Owes me a follow-up on the trek info.
Talked to Jordan Lee after rehearsal, plays trombone, works on UI at a healthcare company, curious about accessibility work.
Dana Whitfield runs the founders' club, knows basically everyone building at Michigan. Offered to make intros for anyone with a real project.
Mentor call with Prof. Elena Ruiz, robotics. Suggested I read up on tactile interfaces; she supervises Maya.
_gap_note: The VC goal should produce a gap for 'climate-tech VC' on the requester's account when the demo teammate (who holds Sam Reyes) is a separate account — move Sam Reyes and Priya Nair to the teammate's seed to stage the Exchange.
